item.title: React Native Windows 0.85
item.description: We're excited to release React Native Windows 0.85.0, built on React Native 0.85.3. React Native Windows v0.85 completes the move to the New Architecture, (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: React.lazy, Suspense and the Hidden 300ms Startup Delay
item.description: Every new tab is a cold start. We set out to shrink our bundle, found that bytes weren't the problem, and traced the real delay to how React reveals lazy-loaded and suspended content. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: TanStack DB 1.0 RC1, and How 'Oracles' Found Its Bugs
item.description: TanStack DB 1.0 RC1 is here. How oracles helped me find whole classes of bugs and rethink programming with agents. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: the migration guide
item.description: This guide covers breaking changes when upgrading from @tanstack/db@0.9.2 to 1.0.0-rc.1, including the accompanying Collection adapter releases. Every "before" example uses the APIs available... (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Ship Less JavaScript in Next.js with Your AI Agent
item.description: Optimize your Next.js app's bundles with the next-bundle-optimizer agent skill, or explore them yourself with new Bundle Analyzer tools. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Porting 287,000 Lines of React to Foldkit in 3 Days
item.description: How Claude ported every screen of Maple's React app to Foldkit, and the pixel, behavior and accessibility harness that decided when each screen was done. (1 source: reactstatus)
